messages:
lucy_support: FYI — GroveMed escalated: invoice INV-2025-0091 is blocked. They want Net45 terms but our onboarding policy requires upfront for new vendors. Also PO split across two POs (PO-8421, PO-8422) and VAT exemption flag not applied. Can finance/legal advise?

raj_billing: Can you drop the invoice + PO numbers here and any payment attempt logs? I can check the reconciliation.

lucy_support: INV-2025-0091, POs: PO-8421, PO-8422. Customer reports initial card attempt failed (they later asked for net terms). Payment log snippet:
```
payment_attempt: id=pa_3GZ8 status=declined code=card_declined reason="insufficient_funds"
```

raj_billing: Got it. Is there a VAT exemption certificate on file for GroveMed? If not, tax engine will re-add VAT and that can block finalization.

lucy_support: Not in the portal — customer says they uploaded it to procurement portal but not our billing form. I asked for a copy, attaching here. (uploaded: grove_vat_cert.pdf)

ana_finance: Policy recap: for brand-new vendors we require upfront payment or approved credit terms after KYC + 2 on-time invoices. We can do a provisional credit exception in time-sensitive launches, but need signoff from legal + finance.

derek_sales: Heads-up — customer launch in 2 weeks. If we delay, they may push launch. Can we do a provisional Net30 with retainage? Sales recommends 75/25 release.

lucy_support: Proposed workflow: 1) Verify VAT cert + attach to invoice, 2) match both PO lines to invoice in AR, 3) finance issues 75% payment to vendor, hold 25% until first paid invoice under Net30.

invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2025-0091 created 2025-04-12; status=blocked_on_PO; assigned_to=raj_billing.

raj_billing: I can run the PO match. If VAT cert is valid we can remove tax hold. To apply the provisional Net30 in our system, I need a finance approval note. Legal, can you confirm we can do retainage? @legal-team

legal-team: We can approve provisional Net30 with 25% retainage for one billing cycle pending KYC results. Need signed addendum: "Provisional Net30 with 25% retainage until vendor KYC completes." I'll draft.

ana_finance: OK from finance. I'll put conditional payment in queue: release 75% once PO lines matched and VAT cert uploaded; hold 25% as AR retainage. Will mark invoice "provisional_paid".

derek_sales: I'll notify the customer and send the addendum. Draft to review: "We agree to provisional Net30 terms on invoice INV-2025-0091 with 25% retainage pending KYC."

lucy_support: I'll update the support ticket and ask customer to re-upload VAT cert into billing portal and confirm PO numbers.

raj_billing: Operational note for ledger team — to set provisional Net30 and retainage run:
```
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/api/v1/invoices/INV-2025-0091/actions \\n  -d '{"action":"set_terms","terms":"provisional_net30","retainage_pct":25,"approved_by":"ana_finance"}'
```

legal-team: Draft addendum uploaded to the thread (addendum_INV-2025-0091.docx) — please review.

lucy_support: Customer confirmed they re-uploaded VAT cert and provided company reg number. They've signed the addendum and returned it to sales.

ana_finance: Processing 75% release now. Will update invoice status to "partially_paid" once posted.

raj_billing: PO match complete. VAT cert valid. Removed tax block.

lucy_support: Customer updated: launch go/no-go moved to "go". Sales says thanks.

derek_sales: Great work team. Please close the ticket when retainage is cleared. :white_check_mark:

lucy_support: Closing note — INV-2025-0091 set to provisional_net30, 75% released, 25% retained pending KYC. Will follow up in 30 days. :eyes:
